carrier_dhl_parcel.page.title: DHL Parcel
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.help: Configure your DHL Parcel credentials in Integration credentials. Credentials are provisioned once through My DHL Portal.
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.credential.use: User ID — UUID from My DHL Portal → Settings → API KEYS
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.credential.api: API Key — secret from My DHL Portal → Settings → API KEYS (shown once only)
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.credential.acc: Account Number — e.g. 01234567, visible in My DHL Portal account section
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.userId.helpTex: UUID from My DHL Portal → Settings → API KEYS
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.apiKey.helpTex: Secret string from My DHL Portal → Settings → API KEYS. Shown only once — copy immediately.
e.g. 01234567 — visible in My DHL Portal account section
carrier_dhl_parcel.config.apiBaseUrl.hel: Leave empty for production. DHL has no separate sandbox host — use test account numbers for sandbox mode.
carrier_dhl_parcel.tracking.title: DHL Parcel Tracking
carrier_dhl_parcel.error.cancellation_no: DHL Parcel does not support shipment cancellation via API.
